register.title: Evan Daniel's n146 certificate at e006ce6, issue606
register.headline: A smaller packing of 146 squares from Evan Daniel's chain search, started from Ryan Xu's packing, certified exactly
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its regularized drawing. The side is the 80-digit KKT point S* = 12.58378219015186034216... scaled by 1 + 1e-20 about the origin corner; the source reports a local minimum strict modulo 59 exact flat motions, 69 corner-corner contacts with no corner-corner MILP descent, and 13 rattlers, and measures it against #505's packing as a different local minimum that agrees to about 1e-7 except a cluster of 10 squares tilted near 42 degrees. Those are numerical evidence, as the source says, not proofs. No source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose chain search found the packing in a time-travel test started from the public packings of 10 October, and credit Ryan Xu's packing of 146 (issue 432, T-125) as its start, as the author asks: two random large perturbations of it and a re-polish, then one exact descent step. The author names Robert Barnett's refinement (T-150, issue 505) as the record it improves and calls the result a different local minimum from it. The search, the checks and the request were done with Claude (Claude Code), which Evan Daniel directed and reviewed.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide adoption at 146: the certificate is below the case's ceiling (T-150) by 1.38e-8 and below every report at 146, PR 574's T-174 included. Final exact-head CI remains required.

bibliography.note: One complete exact certificate at e006ce6230f2240457b083199755a3a5d287692c, s(146) <= 12583782190151860342292508597077/10^30, from a time-travel test of the author's chain search started from the public packings of 10 October; the author credits the start to Ryan Xu's #432 packing and names Barnett's #505 refinement as the record it improves.
